plugins.name: Antigravity Cloak
plugins.description: Rewrites third-party agent fingerprints (PI-Desktop, pi, omp, Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode...) in Antigravity system instructions that Google answers with a false 429. Deletes or rewords text; never inserts invisible characters.
plugins.author: Sakuralaaa

zh-CN.description: 改写发往 Antigravity 的系统提示词里第三方客户端的身份句和已知触发句（PI-Desktop、pi、omp、Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode 等），解决假 429。只删除或改写为中性英文，不插入零宽等隐形字符。
